title: The string inside std::string
description:
See where `std::string` keeps its characters, and when it moves them to the heap.

```
"hi": size 2, capacity 15, data is inside the object (small string)
30 characters: capacity 31, data on the heap
after reserve(100): data moved
```
hints: `auto p{reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(s.data())}; auto o{reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(&s)}; return p >= o && p < o + sizeof s;` (lesson 2.08).
The small-string size differs between standard libraries (15 for MSVC's).
requirements: Print `size()`, `capacity()` and whether `data()` lies inside the string object (compare addresses with `&s` and `sizeof s`).
Grow a string one character at a time and print each time the data pointer changes.
Print the bytes of a UTF-8 string with `é` and count characters vs bytes.
stretch: Do the same for `std::vector` and see that it has no small buffer.
